name: SectionedForm
title: Templates/Platform/Forms/SectionedForm
summary: Standalone field stacks in one column: the platform shell with an unpadded scroll region, a page heading, then the Git scope and repository side by side and sections of field stacks under plain headings, ending with an acknowledgement checkbox and a single Deploy button at the end of the column, with no sticky footer. Import from Git is the example: Template Settings, Deployment, Build and Runtime, Notifications and Alerts, Delivery features. Every required field flags only after Deploy is pressed, through the field’s own required state and helper text. Built from `PageHeader`, the platform shell, `Label`, `Select`, `Field` (with its `FieldLabel`, `FieldDescription`, `FieldContent` and `FieldTitle` parts and choice cards), `Input`, `InputGroup`, `RadioButton`, `MultiSelect`, `PasswordInput`, `Textarea`, `PhoneInput`, `Switch`, `Checkbox`, `HelperText` and `Button`.

variants.name: Submitted
variants.summary: After Deploy on the untouched form: the access token, deployment type, build command, deploy key, on-call number and the acknowledgement each show their required state and message.
